title.en: Start here: the exam, and how we will learn it
title.zh: 从这里开始：这张试卷，以及我们怎么学

description.en: What the six questions are about, why the lessons come in this order, and the two ideas that run through almost every mark.
description.zh: 六道题各讲什么，课为什么按这个顺序排，以及贯穿几乎每一分的两个想法。

text.en: This course is built on one mock exam for ECON90015, Semester 1, 2026: six questions, 100 marks, all in English. You do not need to have taken the course. You need what a first year of university maths gives you, derivatives and solving equations; every idea of economics the questions use is taught here from the beginning.
text.zh: 这门课围绕 ECON90015 的一份模拟考试（2026 年第一学期）展开：六道题，共 100 分，全英文。你不需要上过这门课，只需要大一数学的底子：会求导、会解方程。题目里用到的每个经济学想法，这里都从头讲起。

text.en: Here is what each question is about, as a story. Each lesson starts with its question exactly as printed.
text.zh: 先看看每道题讲的是一件什么事。每一课都从这道题的原文开始。

rows.en: A country buys all its wind turbines from abroad. Its government then limits how many may come in. Who gains and who loses, in dollars?
rows.zh: 一个国家的风机全靠进口。政府随后限制进口数量。谁得谁失，各多少钱？

rows.en: A firm is the only seller of its product. The government then taxes every sale. What does the firm do, and who really pays the tax?
rows.zh: 一家厂商是某种产品的唯一卖家。政府随后对每笔销售征税。厂商会怎么做？税到底是谁付的？

rows.en: One seller, two kinds of customers. Can it charge them differently, and how, when it cannot tell them apart?
rows.zh: 一个卖家，两类顾客。能不能向他们收不同的价？分不清谁是谁的时候又该怎么收？

rows.en: Two firms share a market. Each decides how much to produce, knowing the other is deciding too.
rows.zh: 两家厂商共享一个市场。每家都要决定生产多少，并且知道对方也在做同样的决定。

rows.en: An industry of many small firms, any of which can come or go. Where does the price end up?
rows.zh: 一个行业里有很多小厂商，谁都可以进来或离开。价格最后会停在哪？

rows.en: A whole economy over centuries: what happens to population and living standards when more people arrive?
rows.zh: 一整个经济体，跨越几百年：人口增加了，人口和生活水平会怎样？

title.en: Why the lessons come in this order

text.en: The lessons do not follow the question numbers. They follow the order in which the ideas build on each other, so that every lesson only uses what came before:
text.zh: 课的顺序不按题号，而按想法之间的依赖：每一课只用到前面讲过的东西。

items.en: **Question 1, markets.** What demand and supply curves are, how a market finds its price, and how to measure in dollars who gains. Everything after this uses it.
items.zh: **第 1 题，市场。** 需求曲线和供给曲线到底是什么，市场怎么定出价格，以及怎么用钱衡量谁得了好处。后面每一课都要用到。

items.en: **Question 5, firms and costs.** What it costs a firm to produce, how a firm that cannot affect the price decides how much to make, and why competition drives the price down to cost.
items.zh: **第 5 题，厂商与成本。** 厂商生产要花多少成本，一家影响不了价格的厂商怎么决定产量，以及竞争为什么把价格压到成本。

items.en: **Question 2, one seller.** A monopolist can choose its price. It uses the market of question 1 and the costs of question 5. Then a tax.
items.zh: **第 2 题，独家卖方。** 垄断者可以自己定价。要用到第 1 题的市场和第 5 题的成本。然后加一道税。

items.en: **Question 3, one seller, many prices.** The monopolist of question 2 charges different buyers differently.
items.zh: **第 3 题，独家卖方，多种价格。** 第 2 题的垄断者向不同买家收不同的价。

items.en: **Question 4, two sellers.** Each firm reasons like the monopolist of question 2, but must also guess the other.
items.zh: **第 4 题，两家卖方。** 每家都像第 2 题的垄断者那样思考，还得猜对方。

items.en: **Question 6, the whole economy.** A different kind of question (macroeconomics, argued on a diagram); it stands on its own.
items.zh: **第 6 题，整个经济。** 另一类题（宏观经济学，在图上讲道理）；它自成一体。

text.en: Two ideas you will meet in almost every question
text.zh: 几乎每道题都会遇到的两个想法

text.en: **Decide at the margin.** *Marginal* means *of one more unit*. A bakery asks of each extra loaf: does it bring in more than it costs to bake? If the 50th loaf sells for \$3 and costs \$2 to bake, bake it. If the 80th sells for \$3 but costs \$3.50, do not. The best number of loaves is where one more brings in exactly what it costs. In calculus: profit is highest where its derivative is zero, and the derivative of profit is *what one more unit brings in minus what it costs*.
text.zh: **在边际上做决定。** *边际*（marginal）的意思是*多一个单位的*。面包店对每多烤一个面包都问：它带来的钱比烤它的成本多吗？第 50 个面包卖 3 美元、成本 2 美元，就烤；第 80 个卖 3 美元、成本 3.5 美元，就不烤。最好的数量，是再多一个带来的钱恰好等于它的成本。用微积分说：利润在导数为零处最大，而利润的导数就是*多一个单位带来的钱减去它的成本*。

text.en: **Gains are areas.** If you would pay up to \$8 for something and it costs \$5, you are \$3 better off. Add such gains over everyone who buys and you get an area between a curve and a price line on a diagram. In calculus: an integral; in this exam almost always a triangle or a rectangle.
text.zh: **好处是面积。** 一样东西你最多愿意出 8 美元，结果只花了 5 美元，你就多得了 3 美元。把所有买家的这种好处加起来，在图上就是曲线和价格线之间的一块面积。用微积分说：一个积分；在这张卷子里几乎都是三角形或矩形。

text.en: If these sound abstract now, that is fine: each comes back with real numbers, in the question that needs it.
text.zh: 现在听起来抽象也没关系：每个想法都会在需要它的那道题里，带着具体的数回来。

items.en: **The question**, as printed (in English, with the Chinese under it), then a slow read: what each sentence tells you and what each part asks.
items.zh: **题目**原文（英文，下面附中文），然后慢慢读一遍：每句话告诉你什么，每一小问在问什么。

items.en: **Part by part.** First the idea that part needs, from the ground up, with a figure you can drag where moving it shows more than words; then the solution, with every line said in words. You do the key step yourself.
items.zh: **一小问一小问地来。** 先把这一问需要的想法从头讲清，拖动比文字更能说明问题的地方配一张可以拖的图；再给出解法，每一行都用文字讲明白。关键的一步由你自己来做。

items.en: **On the exam paper**: a full-mark answer, written the way you would write it in the exam.
items.zh: **写在卷面上**：一份满分答案，按考试时该写的样子写出来。

items.en: **The wider topic**: what else an exam on this topic can ask, taught the same way.
items.zh: **这类题的全貌**：这个话题下考试还可能问什么，同样讲清楚。

text.en: The last lesson puts every method on one page and gives you a drill to do under time.
text.zh: 最后一课把所有方法放在一页上，再给你一组限时练习。

body.en: The Chinese version of this course keeps the English terms beside the Chinese, and every model answer is in English, so you can write in the words the examiner expects.
body.zh: 这门课的中文版在专业词旁边保留英文，满分答案也用英文写，方便你直接用阅卷人熟悉的词作答。
